name: Stephanie Parcus
headline: Head of Global Compensation at Church & Dwight

experiences.description: Leads a high-performing team of compensation professionals in the development and execution of enterprise-wide total rewards strategies that align with organizational objectives across complex, global environments. Provides strategic oversight and guidance for Merger, Divestiture & Acquisition activities. Drives executive compensation strategy and governance by partnering with senior leadership and the Compensation Committee to design and implement performance-based programs that reinforce leadership accountability and shareholder value.

Strategic Total Rewards leader in an internally facing role, oversaw a team of global compensation professionals supporting complex, matrixed accountabilities across global business segments, corporate functions, and geographies.

Served as a trusted advisor on all compensation-related matters for the WTW business segment and corporate functions, delivering consultative guidance aligned with enterprise objectives for Global Total Rewards matters.

Acted as subject matter expert on regulatory and compliance issues impacting compensation across North America, including FLSA, pay equity and disparity, and shareholder advisory topics such as Say on Pay.

Led the development of a global variable compensation strategy impacting approximately 10,000 employees across 59 countries.

- Partnered with senior leaders across business units to translate organizational strategy into actionable compensation initiatives.
- Designed benchmark metrics and performance tracking frameworks to evaluate program effectiveness and ensure alignment with strategic goals.
- Developed a comprehensive risk assessment playbook enabling systematic audits of incentive plans to identify potential compliance and governance concerns.

Provided Compensation & Benefits expertise to Latin America region (approx 3,500 ee’s across multiple business units). Built out a regional C&B support model that was sustainable and scaleable across a growing region encompassing 11 Latin American countries and dozens of islands in the Caribbean.

Strategic initiatives included:
- Led implementation of new career framework within region
- Implemented cost-effective, balanced benefit programs in small emerging markets
- Harmonized benefit programs in several established large markets
- Created sustainable, effective sales compensation plans aligning to regional business strategy
- Established best practices around intra-country mobility issues

experiences.position: Compensation Leader, Global Sales & Local Incentives
experiences.description:
Provided leadership and consulting to business leaders globally regarding their incentive compensation programs. Worked to implement and utilize a Global Sales Framework for annual design changes.

Role was a sales compensation SME to Latin American business units to provide them incentive plans that align directly to the short and long term business goals.

Partnered with business leaders to develop core metrics to define sales effectiveness.
Acted as key resource for enterprise driven project teams, including incentive governance, sales effectiveness and global mobility optimization.
